# Rule quality report - ITSM Workflow Intelligence tool

*Generated by `agent-layer/tests/rule_quality.js` - do not edit by hand. Measurement only: **no rule in the tool has been changed**.*

**How to read this.** Each labelled phrase says which team(s) an incident should go to, or whether payment / personal-data wording is really present (labels were written by intent, without looking at the rules' results, by Claude - they need your / a practitioner's review). **Strict** = the suggestion is the best-fit team; **lenient** = any plausible team (or correctly no suggestion). **Proposed A** = join the two fields with a space + whole-word matching, no new keywords. **Proposed B** = A + extra keywords. The proposals were written by the same author as the labels, so the improvement shown is optimistic.

## Pre-flight payment / personal-data keyword scans

```
pre-flight keyword scans (33 labelled phrases)
  CURRENT    phrases handled correctly  15/33 (45%)  | payment-scan FP 6 FN 5; personal-data-scan FP 2 FN 5
  PROPOSED A phrases handled correctly  20/33 (61%)  | payment-scan FP 1 FN 6; personal-data-scan FP 0 FN 6
  PROPOSED B phrases handled correctly  30/33 (91%)  | payment-scan FP 1 FN 0; personal-data-scan FP 0 FN 2
```

**payment-related scan** - current precision 57% / recall 62%; A 88% / 54%; B 93% / 100%
* *Fires when it should not:* "Discard button misaligned"; "Scorecard dashboard slow to load"; "Cardiff office VPN down"; "Fundamentals course page returns 404"; "Cardinality alert noise in monitoring"; "Purchase order PDF layout broken"
* *Misses:* "Apple Pay declines"; "Direct debit run failed"; "BACS submission rejected"; "Payout batch late"; "Merchant settlement report missing"
* *Still misses under A:* "Refund processing stuck"; "Apple Pay declines"; "Direct debit run failed"; "BACS submission rejected"; "Payout batch late"; "Merchant settlement report missing"
* *Residual under B:* "Purchase order PDF layout broken"

**personal-data-related scan** - current precision 78% / recall 58%; A 100% / 50%; B 100% / 83%
* *Fires when it should not:* "Customer dataset loads slowly in the BI tool"; "Account numbering scheme document update"
* *Misses:* "Passport scans stored unencrypted"; "Home address shown to other users"; "National Insurance numbers in export"; "Date of birth visible in URL"; "Card data in logs after payment failure"
* *Still misses under A:* "Email address list leaked"; "Passport scans stored unencrypted"; "Home address shown to other users"; "National Insurance numbers in export"; "Date of birth visible in URL"; "Card data in logs after payment failure"
* *Residual under B:* "Email address list leaked"; "Card data in logs after payment failure"

## Limits of this measurement

* Labels are one author's judgement; several phrases are marked with a note in the corpus.
* The corpus is small and deliberately includes the known substring traps, so it over-represents the hard cases: do NOT read the percentages as production accuracy.
* Routing here ignores a user's own custom routing rules (they take priority in the tool).
* Proposals have not been reviewed by a practitioner and are NOT applied. Any change goes through the signed-off engine-change workstream (Master Plan 7h).
